summary.text: Alex Riley is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 134 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Riley is a Springfield attorney and began serving as House Majority Leader in 2025.

paragraphs.text: Alex Riley was born and lives in Springfield, Missouri.
He earned a B.A. in political science from Thomas Edison State University and a J.D. from Southern Illinois University.
His career experience includes working as an attorney with McAfee & Taft, P.C.
Riley first won District 134 in 2020, defeating Democrat Derrick Nowlin, and took office on January 6, 2021, succeeding Elijah Haahr.
He won re-election in 2022 over Samantha Deaton and was unopposed in the 2024 general election.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the House General Laws Committee and served as vice chair of the Joint Committee on Administrative Rules.
